Chat Edit: '✅ Fix imports

Since you now have folders:

proto/kv
proto/raft


Do this:

In all Go files that import kv proto:

Replace:

"github.com/siddharth-roy27/distributed-kv-store/proto"


or

"github.com/siddharth-roy27/distributed-kv-store/proto/kvpb"


With:

"github.com/siddharth-roy27/distributed-kv-store/proto/kv"

In all Go files that import raft proto:

Replace:

"github.com/siddharth-roy27/distributed-kv-store/proto/raftpb"


With:

"github.com/siddharth-roy27/distributed-kv-store/proto/raft"'

Chat Edit: '❌ Error 2
"log" imported and not used


Remove this import inside:

internal/raft/service.go


Just delete:

"log"

❌ Error 3
undefined: RequestVoteArgs
undefined: RequestVoteReply
undefined: AppendEntriesArgs
undefined: AppendEntriesReply


This happens because in your proto, the names are likely:

From proto/raft/raft.proto

Usually they look like:

message RequestVoteRequest {}
message RequestVoteResponse {}
message AppendEntriesRequest {}
message AppendEntriesResponse {}


But your Go code refers to:

RequestVoteArgs
RequestVoteReply
AppendEntriesArgs
AppendEntriesReply


🚨 Your Go code uses different names than your proto!

✅ Fix Options (Choose ONE)
Option A: Update Go Code to match Proto names

Inside internal/raft/service.go replace:

Old Name (code)	Replace With (proto)
RequestVoteArgs	raft.RequestVoteRequest
RequestVoteReply	raft.RequestVoteResponse
AppendEntriesArgs	raft.AppendEntriesRequest
AppendEntriesReply	raft.AppendEntriesResponse'
